title: Q11
description:
“I will declare Your name to My brethren.”
Read: Psa 22 (whole psalm, especially vv. 1, 16–18, 21–22)
a) Psa 22 begins “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?” and turns at v. 21 to praise among the brethren. What does citing v. 22 bring forward from the whole psalm about the suffering that came before?
